name: Highbroad Advanced Material (Hefei) Co., Ltd.
summary: Highbroad Advanced Material (Hefei) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of backlight display modules and core components in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers thin-film transistor liquid crystal display (TFT-LCD) and Mini-LED backlight display modules; reflectors; diffusion and prism sheets; Mini-LED light panels; lamp board driver design; streaming media rearview mirror design; light guide plates; precision structural parts; optical materials; and other related components.
